blocks.h2: Adding a Disposal to an Older Kitchen
blocks.body: Many older Evanston kitchens were built without a disposal. Adding one usually takes three things: a switched outlet under the sink, a drain that can handle ground food and enough room in the cabinet. We'll check the drain first, since older pipe with grease buildup should be cleaned before a disposal starts sending more food down it. If the dishwasher drains through the sink, we connect it to the disposal.

blocks.h2: What Affects the Price of a Disposal Job
blocks.body: A straight swap is the simplest job. A first-time install may need an outlet, a new trap and drain changes, especially in older kitchens. If the drain beyond the sink is partly clogged, it should be cleared first. We check everything and quote a flat price.

blocks.h2: Garbage Disposal Questions From Evanston Homeowners

items.q: Can you install a disposal where there wasn't one?
items.answer: Usually. We may need to add an outlet and adjust the drain.

items.q: My disposal hums. What should I do?
items.preview: Turn it off. It's probably jammed.
items.answer: Turn it off. Try the reset button and the hex key under the unit. If it won't turn, call us.

items.q: Should I repair or replace it?
items.preview: If it leaks from the body or is old, replace it.
items.answer: If the body leaks or it's more than about 10 years old, replacing it usually makes more sense.

items.q: What shouldn't go in a disposal?
items.preview: Grease, fibrous food and coffee grounds.
items.answer: Grease, celery and other fibrous food, eggshells in quantity and coffee grounds.

items.q: Do I need an electrician for a disposal?
items.answer: Only if there's no outlet under the sink. We'll tell you before we start.

items.preview: Food trapped under the splash guard.
items.answer: Usually food trapped under the rubber splash guard. Cleaning it often fixes the smell.

items.preview: Small ones, sometimes. It's better not to.
items.answer: Some can grind small bones, but it's hard on the unit. It's better to keep them out.

items.q: How much does garbage disposal installation cost in Evanston?
items.preview: It depends on the unit. You'll approve a flat price first.
items.answer: It depends on the unit and the connections. You'll approve a flat-rate price before we start.
